best: Clean left-to-right power paths with titled, annotated blocks: the gauge FET path, sense resistor and four-switch stage read like textbook drawings with values legible and no overlaps.
worst: USB sheets tie the charger controller to its four-switch power stage, and the PD controller to the connector block, only through same-sheet text net labels (HIDRV1, SW1, PPHV, CC1/CC2) across large distances
Gauge VC1-VC4 filter inputs reach U101 through long stepped wires and thermistors TS1-TS4 sit in a separate box tied only by labels
Port 2 sheet keeps stale port-1 text in block subtitles (Q401/Q402, Q409), and some labels on the USB sheets are dense small text crowding pin numbers (e.g. DRAIN (15) on U401)
